evals.name: explicit-router
evals.prompt: Draw a wifi router in Slign style and save it as router.svg in this folder.
evals.expected_output: router.svg: a single-ink isometric router with a face and its own hover gesture.

evals.name: implicit-empty-state
evals.prompt: This is the alerts page of Pingboard, my uptime monitor. The empty state looks dead. Add a small illustration above the text so it feels friendlier, something that fits a monitoring tool.
evals.expected_output: index.html with an inline illustration in the empty state that takes the text color and reacts on hover.

evals.name: implicit-next-404
evals.prompt: our 404 is super boring. can you add some kind of little drawing to it? we're a deploy tool so maybe something on that theme. keep it light, no new dependencies
evals.expected_output: app/not-found.tsx with an inline SVG as valid JSX, no client directive, no new dependency.

evals.name: restyle-and-trigger
evals.prompt: Add an illustration of a database to index.html inside a card. It should be green (#1f9d55), about 120px wide, and it should animate when I hover anywhere on the card, not just on the drawing.
evals.expected_output: index.html with a card that carries data-slign-trigger, an inline database drawing colored through CSS and sized to about 120px.
